ruleset.name: judas-quality
ruleset.description: JUDAS quality gates (spec §16.1), taken from the POC ruleset. - CyclomaticComplexity: per-method complexity <= 7 (reportLevel 8); the class total is not gated. - NcssCount: method size in statements (PMD 7 has no line numbers in XPath). Duplication is measured by CPD (maven-pmd-plugin, minimumTokens=100).
